headline: AtkinsRéalis Lowers Organic Revenue Growth Guidance as Q3 Profit Slips
summary: AtkinsRéalis reported a drop in third-quarter profit alongside higher revenue, prompting the engineering firm to lower its guidance for organic revenue growth in its engineering services regions business.
why: Engineering and infrastructure consultancies provide bellwether metrics for global capital spending on construction and project execution.

impacts.name: AtkinsRéalis Group Inc.
impacts.why: Lowered organic revenue growth guidance and falling quarterly profit weigh on investor sentiment.
